dedupe_keys.name: hdl handle net dams and flood defences datasets

description: hdl.handle.net: dams and flood defences datasets is a collection of datasets listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by hdl.handle.net. Coverage: the area served by hdl.handle.net. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about dams and flood defences; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Zonas inundables de la presa de Albagés, hipótesis H2, rotura de presa; Zonas inundables de la presa de El Grado, hipótesis H3, rotura de pres; Zonas inundables de la presa de Llauset, hipótesis H2, rotura de presa; Zonas inundables de la presa de Barasona, hipótesis H2, rotura de pres. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://governobert.gencat.cat/ca/dades_obertes/llicencia-oberta-informacio-catalunya/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
